description: Database Topografico - TEMA: RETE ELETTRICA is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Basilicata. Appartiene allo strato Reti di sottoservizi con tutte le reti tecnologiche propriamente dette, mentre i relativi manufatti (pozzetti, chiusini, ecc.) sono appartenenti allo strato dei Manufatti. Metadati del [Catalogo Regionale CRDT] (. Coverage: Regione Basilicata. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Basilicata. Its tags are basilicata, carta-tecnica, cartografia, cartografia-di-base, ctr. It offers 8 resource(s) in KML, WMS, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-01-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is IODL-2.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
